title: Tuning
description: The shape of content/tuning.json: the balance runner's tables of tuning starting points from docs/03-GAME-DESIGN.md §2–§12 (CLAUDE.md rule 3: every number lives here or in content, never in code). A tree of sections whose leaves are numbers, {value, note} pairs (a number, boolean or short string with the reason it has that value), booleans, short strings (ids, colours, section sources) or null, with arrays of the same. The sim reads it through the TypeScript type derived from the file, so the key names are the contract; this schema guards the leaf shapes and the top-level sections.

floors.description: 07 §2.3–§2.6, §2.10: the floors' own numbers the content files do not carry — trap odds per room, gauntlet sizes, a Monster room per floor, the Funeral Urns' per-urn odds, the Mourner's Candles' quiet rooms (pass C1, Phase 7).

merchant.description: 07 §2.7: Dunmore Quist's stock — the lines, their counts and town prices in R, the zone's safe items, gear, the stone chance, his lamp, and the four Torches before the throne (D-099; pass C1, Phase 7).

bands.description: 08's R table: the global floors of each band, its centre grade and R; the chest band's cap (D-104; pass C1, Phase 7).

techniques.description: 09 §4, 03 §7.5: monster techniques — the flat chance per witnessed use and the guarantee by the Nth (D-028, D-099; pass A, Phase 7).

pacts.description: 07 §6: the Oath thresholds of the Pact menu and how Pact knobs combine with a preset (pass D, Phase 7).

contracts.description: 07 §7: the Quest Board — dailies, the weekly, the reset hour, the weekly key caps (pass D, Phase 7).

ammo.description: 08 §4: arrows and bolts — the quiver, the empty-quiver Bash, Repair all refills (D-099; pass D, Phase 7).

runner.description: The balance runner's own numbers (12 Phase 7, 07 §8.2): its targets, recipes, seeds and the scripted players' knobs. Optional: the game never reads it.

arena.description: 07 §2.8, 06 §8.10: the boss-arena engine's own numbers — the tell's wind-up, what breaks it, re-entering adds, the returning hunters, the scripted heroes' arena habits (pass C2, Phase 7).

items.description: 08 §1–§7: the item rules the content files do not carry — the armor percent step from B, the loot-table band rows the linter checks, uniques and sets in a roll, relic actions (pass B, Phase 7).

chests.description: 08 §10, 07 §7: the Curio Merchant — the Grand chests' pity advance, crate sizes, the Tome tier odds, the Divine Shard line and chest keys (pass B, Phase 7).

section.description: One rulebook section's numbers. `source` names the section they come from.

notedLeaf.description: A leaf whose reason travels with it: the Proposed readings of the rulebook's open questions carry one (D-055).

node.description: A leaf or a nested table. A table never has a key called `value` (that shape is a notedLeaf).
